title: Preventative Maintenance for Wide Format Printer and Scanner
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEFENSE FINANCE AND ACCOUNTING SERVICE (DFAS) > DEFENSE FINANCE AND ACCOUNTING SVC
description: This requirement is to establish a Service and Preventative Maintenance contract to continue support for existing Canon Colorwave 3600 Network Printer and Scanner. Support is for base plus four one-year options. See attached SOW for additional information.
